verdicts.rationale: The C4 buff is authored with an enemyHpBelow:50 gate on a passive trigger. Because the planner cannot simulate enemy HP, the condition resolves null and the buff renders as a persistent always-active window (confirmed: evalCondition returns null for enemyHpBelow, and buffWindows admits null-resolving effects with !== false). In game this is an execute-phase buff applying only against opponents below 50% HP, so the timeline over-shows it. This is the standard optimistic enemy-HP gate the style guide lists as 'render assumed-true + caveat' and explicitly marks never-implementDelete (nothing further to wire — enemy HP is unsimulable). It passes the purpose test: a player would otherwise read the burst DMG bonus as up all rotation. Not implement (already wired, no expressible residual). The separate over-render against ALL burst DMG rather than just the Lightfall Sword is a damage-scoping detail with no rendered surface (no damage numbers; the buff bar doesn't distinguish hits) — that half is noCaveat and not caveated.
verdicts.proposedText: Shown as always active, but in game the bonus only applies against opponents below 50% HP.
